summary: DeepMind researchers report two empirical studies on LLM-facilitated group deliberation in a charity allocation task, finding no consensus improvement but risks of algorithmic steering and an illusion of inclusion.

practices.reason: Describes an evaluation methodology for measuring steering and participation equity in AI-mediated group deliberation, relevant to trust and safety evaluation practice but not transferable to typical model-serving teams.
practices.quote: motivating evaluation practices that treat collective outcomes, interaction dynamics, and participant perceptions as distinct governance targets
